source_inputs: E1 evidence map workbook References R01–R70
mechanism_notes: Demonstrates that C. scindens and secondary bile-acid production can protect against C. difficile, showing the same bile-acid function can be protective in one disease context.

author: Lahti et al.
title: Tipping elements in the human intestinal ecosystem
source_inputs: E1 evidence map workbook References R01–R70
mechanism_notes: Identifies abrupt transitions and tipping-element behavior in human gut communities, supporting regime-shift rather than purely gradual-change models.
